description: 211 Iowa connects residents with local food, housing, utility and other community resources by telephone, text and online search.
introduction: 211 Iowa connects residents with local food, housing, utility and other community resources by telephone, text and online search.

sections.who: Anyone looking for local resources can contact 211. Each organization receiving a referral applies its own eligibility and availability rules.
sections.get: A specialist or directory helps identify services near your location. A referral does not itself approve financial help.
sections.docs: Have your ZIP code and a short description of the help needed. Note deadlines, disconnected utilities or an immediate lack of shelter before contacting a provider.
sections.apply:
1. Call 211, text your ZIP code to 898211, or use 211 Iowa’s directory.

  2. Ask which agency serves your address, how to contact it and whether an appointment is needed.
sections.after: Contact the referred provider directly. If it cannot help, return to 211 with that information and ask about alternatives.
